extracted.intended_audience: Researchers / authors submitting papers to arXiv
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for when arXiv submissions become public (announcement schedule) and how arXiv identifiers are assigned, including moderation, deferred mailings, and special-case handling (replacements, withdrawals, cross-listings, journal references).

rubrics_metrics.name: Submissions are typically made public Sunday through Thursday
rubrics_metrics.description: Submissions to arXiv are typically made public Sunday through Thursday, with no announcements Friday or Saturday.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should check the current arXiv main site time and the amount of time remaining before the deadline. Public appearance of a submission occurs as part of the scheduled announcement process. Note that this schedule applies to usual processing; exceptions (e.g., moderation, deferred mailings) can alter timing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Announcement Schedule (submission receipt window → announcement/mail time)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submissions received during specified Eastern US time windows are announced at specific times and mailed to subscribers on a predictable schedule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
Schedule (all times Eastern US):
- Monday 14:00 – Tuesday 14:00 → Will be announced Tuesday 20:00; Mailed to subscribers Tuesday night / Wednesday morning
- Tuesday 14:00 – Wednesday 14:00 → Will be announced Wednesday 20:00; Mailed to subscribers Wednesday night / Thursday morning
- Wednesday 14:00 – Thursday 14:00 → Will be announced Thursday 20:00; Mailed to subscribers Thursday night / Friday morning
- Thursday 14:00 – Friday 14:00 → Will be announced Sunday 20:00; Mailed to subscribers Sunday night / Monday morning
- Friday 14:00 – Monday 14:00 → Will be announced Monday 20:00; Mailed to subscribers Monday night / Tuesday morning
Authors should use these windows to estimate when their submission will be announced, noting the timezone is Eastern US.

rubrics_metrics.name: All submissions are subject to moderation
rubrics_metrics.description: Note that all submissions are subject to moderation which may result in delays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Moderation can delay the normal announcement schedule. Authors should not assume the standard timing if the submission is held for moderation; expect potential delays and check account/dashboard or moderation notices for status updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of items included in the announcement process
rubrics_metrics.description: Announcements include new submissions as well as replacements, withdrawal notices, cross listings and journal reference updates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Journal reference submissions are processed at the same time but do not appear in the mailings. Authors should be aware that although these item types are handled during the announcement process, how they appear to subscribers can differ (e.g., journal references won't be in the mailed announcements).

rubrics_metrics.name: arXiv identifier assignment timing and limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: The final arXiv identifier is assigned as part of the automated process when the work is announced; it is not possible to generate or be provided with the arXiv identifier or DOI in advance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitting authors will receive an email when the work is announced and the identifier will appear on their account dashboard. The arXiv identifier cannot be back-dated: identifiers are assigned in the month of first announcement, and a submission may appear with an identifier month different from its original submission date due to processing factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deferred mailings (holidays and ad hoc deferrals)
rubrics_metrics.description: arXiv may defer a mailing occasionally for locally celebrated holidays or ad hoc reasons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information about deferred mailings is posted on the arXiv status page or the arXiv blog. Authors should consult those resources around holidays or if an expected announcement does not occur on schedule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Published holiday schedule (example: 2026 holidays)
rubrics_metrics.description: arXiv lists specific holidays when mailings may be affected (example provided for 2026).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provided 2026 dates (examples of holidays that can affect mailings): 2026-01-01, 2026-01-19, 2026-06-19, 2026-07-03, 2026-09-07, 2026-11-26, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-29, 2026-12-31. Authors should plan around known holidays and check for any year-specific schedule updates.
